environment: maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-21; pinned reference; test harness only; no production rule changes
scope: 20 actual total-power queries for one to four droids and zero to four Rebels; eight location/source/target-state queries; two actual battle forfeiture orders; two actual C-3PO deployments with/without Imperial Barrier, complete exclusion responses, power-segment totals, current forfeit, and post-battle reactivation. All32 rows compared against native execution. Power is sampled before GEMP clears its power fields in damage.
limitations: Ground-character components only; aboard/captured/crossed-over/dual-type contexts remain required.
R2-D2 remains metadata-only; its own Scomp-link responses, floating destiny and pilot bonuses are not implemented by this checkpoint.
Native reset/cap/inactive-stack/attached-character cases are component checks, not fresh GEMP traces.
Barrier final effects and post-battle reactivation agree; this does not certify every before-exclusion prevention/response window.
officialRules: https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf (p139 C-3PO distinct pairs; p60 battle exclusion)
